notes.title: Update 03.12.2024. Devlog #1: Small Updates and Bug Fixes.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome to my very first devlog, where I share a quick overview of the latest updates and fixes in the project.

UPDATES

New room types have been added. Now the map will look a little more diverse.

Added: corner walls, small passages, and space between some walls and the ceiling.
Before:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/ad2a24d1e512d3c24c021c507f90df42a2cfa182.png
After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/76546087e1648f47fa1755c22c01606684bd7aa2.png

Now textures and sounds for the enemy are saved and you don't need to import them every time.

Previously, after game restart or leave to menu, your textures and sounds were reset. Now, the path to them is always saved.

An image was added to the achievement.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291977/55f8515f138f7ac3f5040df883c55ff7bf728acf.jpg

BUG FIX

Now the enemy does not get stuck on the edge of the map

Previously, when you were near the edge of the map, the enemy would choose a destination point beyond the map's boundary and remain stuck there until the player came into their sight. Now, if the enemy fails to reach their destination within a certain time, they will change their destination point.

Now the enemy texture is saved after death and pressing the "Restart" button

Previously, аfter pressing "Restart" button, enemy texture would reset to default, but sound would remain custom. Now, after pressing "Restart" button, texture and sound stay custom.
